pages.title: Can Capture Any Mob
pages.text: In theory, this Capture Talisman can capture any mob — as long as you are quick enough, you can take anything with you!$(br2)When a sword warrior's health drops to 1 or below, a severe injury capture effect will trigger immediately, giving one Capture Talisman directly into the player's inventory.$(br2)But beware: this effect has a built-in cooldown; repeated triggers within the cooldown will not work.$(br2)See the next page for the recipe.

pages.title: Only Captures Touken Danshi
pages.text: The effect is limited to Touken Danshi that belong to the player.$(br2)Using the Group Capture Talisman allows you to capture all of the player's own Touken Danshi within 32 blocks in one go.
